name: Tanguar Haor
summary: A huge wetland of lakes and floating villages with spectacular monsoon boat stays and big winter bird flocks. Best for slow boat travel.
season_note: July to October is the high-water season (boat travel at its best). Winter has migratory birds.
avoid_note: Storms on open water: choose reliable boats with life jackets and check the forecast.

reach.how: AC coach from Dhaka (Sayedabad, Kamalapur) to Sunamganj - about 8 hours
reach.note: Boats usually leave from Tahirpur or Sunamganj.

reach.how: Train to Sylhet, then bus or car to Sunamganj

local.note: Price depends on boat size and group; negotiate through a reliable operator.

attractions.name: Overnight house-boat on the haor
attractions.what: Sleep on a boat, watch the sunrise over the water and eat fresh fish.
attractions.tip: Take a life jacket and a power bank.

attractions.name: Tanguar Haor watchtower
attractions.what: A tower with a wide view over the haor.

attractions.name: Shimul Bagan (Swamp forest)
attractions.what: A forest of swamp trees, beautiful in the monsoon.

attractions.name: Winter birds and fishing villages
attractions.what: Large flocks of migratory birds in winter and local fishing life.

attractions.name: Jadukata River and Barik Tila
attractions.what: A clear river and a small hill nearby.

rules: Wear a life jacket on boats.
